items.title: 17.10 RC series circuit se AC (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 17.10 and Example 17.6 (PDF 99-100).

blocks.text: Resistance R aur capacitor C series mein alternating voltage source V se jure hain (Fig. 17.9(a)). Series mein hone ki wajah se dono mein ek hi current behta hai. R par voltage V_R = Iᵣₘₛ R hai aur yeh current ke saath in phase hai. Voltage aur current ka vector diagram Fig. 17.9(b) mein hai. Current ko reference (hawala) maan kar V_R ko current wali lakeer ke saath hi banate hain. Capacitor par voltage:
Capacitor par voltage current se π/2 rad (90°) peeche hota hai, is liye Iᵣₘₛ X_C wala vector current ki lakeer par seedha khara (90° par) banate hain (Fig. 17.9(b)).

blocks.alt: (a) AC source V ke saath series mein resistor R aur capacitor C; current I; dohre teer R par VR aur C par VC dikhate; chhote khaake VR ko I ke saath in phase aur VC ko I se 90 darje peeche dikhate. (b) Phasors: current I ki simt mein VR = Irms R, neeche 90 darje par VC = Irms XC, aur nateeja Vrms = Irms Z, I se theta zawiye par neeche.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.9 (a), (b): (a) RC series circuit; (b) RC series circuit ke voltage phasors (kitab ki Figure 17.9 (a), (b) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Circuit mein current chalane wala kul voltage Vᵣₘₛ in do vectors, Iᵣₘₛ R aur Iᵣₘₛ/ωC, ka resultant hai. Dono 90° par hain, is liye Pythagoras se:

Eq. 17.21 batati hai ke series AC circuit ki impedance vectors jama kar ke milti hai. R ko current (reference) ki simt mein ek horizontal lakeer se dikhate hain. Reactance X_C = 1/ωC ko R wali lakeer se 90° peeche (neeche) ki lakeer se dikhate hain (Fig. 17.9(c)). Z in dono ka vector sum hai; Fig. 17.9(c) circuit ka impedance diagram kehlata hai. Z wali lakeer R wali lakeer se jo angle θ banati hai, wahi voltage aur current ka phase difference hai: RC circuit mein current lagaye gaye voltage se θ angle aage hota hai (Fig. 17.9(d)):

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab aakhri hissa tan⁻¹(1/2πfC) chhapti hai, R reh gaya hai. Sahi tan⁻¹(1/2πfCR) hai (ω = 2πf rakhein). Example 17.6 bhi yahi sahi formula istemal karti hai.

blocks.alt: (c) Impedance diagram: R ufqi, XC neeche amudan aur Z wattar jo R se theta zawiya banata hai. (d) Voltage V aur current I, omega t 0 se 360 darje tak, aik hi period; I har nuqte par V se theta pehle pohanchta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.9 (c), (d): (c) RC series circuit ka impedance diagram; (d) RC series circuit mein voltage aur current ki waves (kitab ki Figure 17.9 (c), (d) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Fig. 17.9(d) mein current voltage se poora 90° aage aur alag frequency par bana hai. Series circuit mein dono ki frequency ek hi hoti hai, aur RC circuit mein current voltage se sirf angle θ aage hota hai (0° aur 90° ke darmiyan), jaisa impedance diagram (c) dikhata hai; khaake mein yahi sahi surat hai.
RC series circuit mein power asal mein resistor kharch karta hai; capacitor sirf energy jama karta hai, kharch nahi karta. Resistor ki power:
Yahan I current, R resistance, V voltage aur θ voltage aur current ka phase angle hai. cos θ ko power factor kehte hain.

blocks.title: Example 17.6
blocks.problem: 5 kΩ ka resistor aur 5 μF ka capacitor series mein 220 V, 50 Hz ke AC source se jure hain. Phase angle nikalein.
steps: Diya gaya: R = 5 kΩ = 5000 Ω, C = 5 μF = 5 × 10⁻⁶ F, f = 50 Hz
Phase angle θ = tan⁻¹(1/ωCR), aur ω = 2πf, is liye θ = tan⁻¹(1/2πfCR)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab sawal mein capacitance '5 F' likhti hai lekin hal mein 5 μF (5 × 10⁻⁶ F) istemal karti hai; sahi 5 μF hai. Aakhri line mein resistance '5000 W' chhapi hai; sahi 5000 Ω hai.

blocks.prompt: Example 17.6 ke circuit (R = 5000 Ω, C = 5 μF, 220 V, 50 Hz) ki impedance aur rms current nikalein.

items: Current voltage se θ = tan⁻¹(1/ωCR) aage.
Power sirf R mein: P = I²R = VI cos θ.
